items.title: 66096_Monk Montgomery oral history interview
items.q: Carl's from my home town. And I felt comfortable about Carl being there

ctx.x: And so I joined Batman for that New Year's Eve party. And I had my bass and my amp in the trunk of the car when we rode, in Batman's trunk. When we got there the house...it was in a house...was filled with people. A good time, like a party. And the music was just great, because guys was just playing. I mean the music was so powerful!

And I remember that Carl Perkins was playing piano. Carl's from my home town. And I felt comfortable about Carl being there because Carl was like, sort of a key figure. A great player, and knew all the tunes and everything.

And there was about three bass players. Myself, one bass in the corner, another bass playing, another guy playing upright...about three basses. And...but I wanted to play; I really wanted to play. I was hungry to play, really hungry to play.
